actionCalls.name: Send_Investor_Welcome_Email
actionCalls.label: Send Investor Welcome Email
actionCalls.description: Sends the Investor Welcome Lightning email template to the new Contact and logs it on the Contact's activity timeline. Deliberately does NOT set relatedRecordId (WhatId) -- WhatId only accepts "What" entities (Account, Opportunity, Case, Campaign, custom objects), never a "Who" entity like Contact. This action runs off a Contact record, so binding relatedRecordId to $Record.Id fails at runtime with "Invalid entity type for whatId." recipientId plus logEmailOnSend=true alone are sufficient to log the email on the Contact's activity timeline. Do not re-add relatedRecordId here. The template referenced by emailTemplateId (rec_EmailTemplate.Id) is now a genuine Lightning (SFX, UiType=SFX) template, DeveloperName Investor_Welcome_Email_LTN, loaded as a DATA record by scripts/load-lightning-email-templates.apex rather than deployed via force-app metadata -- its RelatedEntityType is Contact and it uses live {{{Recipient.*}}} merge fields, since the recipient here IS the investor.

decisions.name: Decision_Ready_To_Send
decisions.label: Template Found and Email Present?
decisions.description: Confirms the Investor Welcome Email template was found and the Contact has an email address before attempting to send the welcome email.

Flow.description: Sends the Investor Welcome Lightning (SFX) email template to a newly created Investor-record-type Contact and logs it on the Contact's activity timeline. The template is resolved at runtime by DeveloperName (Investor_Welcome_Email_LTN), NOT the pre-existing classic (Aloha) Investor_Welcome_Email template, which this flow no longer references. The Lightning template is record-managed via scripts/load-lightning-email-templates.apex (idempotent DML upsert by DeveloperName) rather than deployed as force-app metadata, because the Metadata API EmailTemplate type has no element that carries HtmlValue as Lightning Builder content.
Flow.label: Investor Welcome Flow

recordLookups.name: Get_Investor_Welcome_Email_Template
recordLookups.label: Get Investor Welcome Email Template
recordLookups.description: Looks up the Investor Welcome Email Lightning (SFX) email template by its developer name so the send-email step can reference it by Id. Filters on Investor_Welcome_Email_LTN, NOT Investor_Welcome_Email -- the latter is the pre-existing CLASSIC (Aloha) template in the IR_Email_Templates folder. MEASURED (Savepoint-wrapped DML probe, DPEG-IR-Implementation): EmailTemplate.DeveloperName is unique ORG-WIDE, not merely per-folder, so the two templates could not share a DeveloperName even in different folders -- the Lightning template was therefore given the distinct DeveloperName Investor_Welcome_Email_LTN, which by itself is already unambiguous (no UiType/RelatedEntityType filter is needed).
